[composition](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#composition-law). Bind, Acquire,
Transform, Evaluate, Conjoin and Dispose organise these responsibilities. Domain
instances bind their predicates, policies and grants; they do not copy a rival
generic law or acquire a new runtime API.
Responsibility views project selected material clauses:
[work/recovery](frames/WORK_RECOVERY.md),
[evaluation/conjunction](frames/EVALUATION_CONJUNCTION.md),
[constitutional derivation](frames/CONSTITUTIONAL_DERIVATION.md),
[domain binding](frames/DOMAIN_BINDING.md), and
[release/adoption](frames/RELEASE_ADOPTION.md). Each has an explicit scope;
no view is sufficient for every task.

For construction or assessment of one member, the
[member construction/assessment view](frames/MEMBER_CONSTRUCTION_ASSESSMENT.md)
supplies generic method rules. Bind it to the actual Product requirements,
member subject, authority and required evidence. Product-specific acceptance
criteria remain at their owner; selecting this view grants no acceptance.

For intake triage, lawful re-entry, work-carrier selection or execution-contract
admission, acquire the [triage/carrier frame](frames/TRIAGE_CARRIER.md).
For typed construction handoffs and transformation admission, acquire the
[constitutional-derivation frame](frames/CONSTITUTIONAL_DERIVATION.md), which
projects the library specialization, its Design Method consumer and the
SPEC_METHOD enclosing-admission owner. These selections follow the task's
responsibility. Each view names its owner sections and exact member digests. Material
coupled responsibilities outside the selection require source re-entry under
the existing sufficiency law; a prepared frame grants no work or admission.

## Method owners

| Responsibility | Owning or locating member |
|---|---|
| Formal carrier-neutral calculus | [Axiomatic Calculus](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md) |
| Generic frame law: declaration, evaluation and composition | [Reference Frame Method](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md); [Spec semantic resolution](SPEC_METHOD.md#bounded-context-semantic-resolution) owns bounded-context term resolution |
| Operational/specialist and Executive configurations | [Reference Frame Baseline](STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md) |
| Constitutional WHAT and lawful construction | [Spec Method](SPEC_METHOD.md) |
| Structural HOW, transformation admission and realization | [Design Module Method](DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md) |
| Scoped names and exact identities | [Identity Method](IDENTITY_METHOD.md) |
| Graph-native domain | [ODD Method](ODD_METHOD.md) |
| Application-neutral traversal model family (adoption optional) | [Traversal Occurrence Profile](TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE_PROFILE.md) |
| State, treatment and world-model claims | [World Model Method](WORLD_MODEL_METHOD.md) |
| UX surface realization | [UX Method](UX_METHOD.md) |
| Work-carrier governance and operating law | [Ticket Method](TICKET_METHOD.md) |
| Exact cuts, successor conservation, publication and adoption protocol | [Release Method](RELEASE_METHOD.md); [Spec Method](SPEC_METHOD.md) owns Product-definition routing; each consumer's authority decides its adoption |
| Commentary and writing practice | [Posting Guide](POSTING_GUIDE.md), [Writing Guide](WRITING_GUIDE.md) |
| Semantic discovery and locator resolution | [Glossary Guide](GLOSSARY_GUIDE.md) |

Each member's declared applicability and scope remain at that owner; this table
does not reclassify a constitutional method as a guide or profile. The calculus
and optional Traversal profile retain their own signatures; the Baseline
retains its adoption boundary. Reference Frame Method supplies generic frame
law; particular actor configurations remain scoped profiles. The Glossary
owns resolution of its locators, while each located method owns its meaning.
Foundations and the library
declare the premise layer and shared conditional contracts under the Methodology
Product authority. Particular methods apply those shared decisions and retain their additional
policies and grants.

A derived profile retains its owning determinations under the
[Baseline authority boundary](STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#status-and-authority-boundary). The calculus is distinct from
interpreted a_c subject models and separately owned mechanical encodings.
Traversal adoption is optional and binds an exact signature and basis.

## Distribution and entry

[Compressions](authority_compressions/README.md) are digest-bound, non-deciding
read models. Each raw member retains its source-owned semantic standing; the detailed
deciding owners remain authoritative. A sufficient
current projection conveys their duties without acquiring authority, and stale
or insufficient views require acquisition of their exact owners. [Templates](templates/README.md)
provide starter realizations: a single per-Product Definition, project specification
templates, a project frame basis and agent bootstrap templates. Normative
interoperability schemas under `schemas/` define the layout-neutral Product
Definition Overlay and deterministic installed-release manifest. Plugin interaction assets route work;
they mint no authority or workflow engine.

The toolchain installs a complete immutable cut in a shared versioned store and
resolves logical release URIs without machine-local paths in Product Definitions.
A local copy is operative only when explicitly bound and verified; it is not
the default. An exact cut, Product Definition basis URI, manifest digest
and member inventory establish consumer basis. A mutable source head or moving
selector cannot replace it. Distribution artifact presence conveys no release
or operation authority.

Under [Frame Method sufficiency](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#rf-003-material-sufficiency)
and [irrelevance exclusion](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#rf-004-irrelevance-exclusion),
acquire the sufficient responsibility frame, exact subject and material
dependencies for one action. The entire corpus is acquired only when material
to the selected claim. The applicable owner determines how the frame's result,
required independent assessment and existing disposition/control contract are
consumed. In ODD, the next work decision remains the exact evaluate_next path;
this entry creates no alternative continuation owner. The projected frames are
declared members of the complete
constitutional member set. Their source owners, exact bytes and fidelity remain
required; a frame is not an independently selectable method version.

The [method interpretation](../interpretation/README.md) supplies the encoded
determinations, source routes and unresolved conditions for symbolic acquisition.
Its document-source inventory is distinct from the complete package inventory.
Use its declared projection and re-entry contract when an interpretation is
material to the task. The underlying owners decide meaning, while the encoded
relation and its checker supply only their declared evidence. Reading this
source package for assessment neither changes an operative Product basis nor
establishes an installed release.

transaction.

and each effect is a separately identified operation under an owner-issued
grant. The profile supplies finite record and history policies for those
conditions; neither calculus availability nor a recorded occurrence adopts them.

Finite observation permits unknown completion (F5). A readiness judgment can authorize dispatch without proving its later effect, and unauthorized mutation remains an observed effect. | This profile chooses `SubjectBinding`, exact grant joins, pre/post observations and the closed disposition/readiness relations. model-family signature for immutable application histories over an externally

1	# ODD Method
2	
3	<!-- STDO3_PROFILE_BINDING_START -->
4	## Governing Relations
5	
6	This graph-native profile applies in a Product-declared ODD scope under lawful
7	activation. Its consumer binds the ODD, GTL and ABG roles to concrete
8	realizations; availability selects neither a package nor a Product meaning or
9	grant. Spec, Design, Frame, Ticket, Release, World Model and UX retain their
10	own applicability and owners.
11	
12	At each published action and evaluation boundary, apply
13	[Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) with the
14	exact selected Product outcome or admitted bounded prerequisite/experiment,
15	IntentLineage, TargetObligationBinding, published action contract, current
16	execution basis and consumer-bound authority. Its material dependencies are
17	the inputs and causal predecessors declared by the constructive loop.
18	[Constraint surface](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#constraint-surface) bounds the
19	worker's external obligations while leaving its internal HOW open.
20	
21	This member owns graph-native actions, cumulative typed environments, admitted
22	runtime facts and the four-function consequence loop. Their exact functions,
23	carriers, control grants and domain outcomes below specialize shared
24	preservation, projection, currentness and result law. They require no additional
25	generic workflow, runtime API, categorical-equivalence claim or actor hierarchy.
26	
27	These arguments use [F1–F6](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundational-commitments)
28	within an adopted graph-native scope. The Product supplies its outcome and
29	domain meanings; workers may change a workspace; the selected runtime admits
30	evidence and governs traversal. Those instance conditions make outcome,
31	observation, admission and continuation different questions. The particular
32	graph, ledger and four-function architecture remains this profile's choice.
33	
34	| Determination and consuming law | Conditional argument | Additional ODD policy and owner |
35	|---|---|---|
36	| Published carrier and composition: [11.1–11.4](#111-typed-assets-and-nodes-are-explicit), [11.8](#118-cumulative-environment-law-is-mandatory) | Algebraic and functional composition require every material input at the consuming function, with its type and meaning intact (F2/F4). Outcome-driven construction needs a declared operative carrier, not only an artifact description (F1/F6). Last-output wiring fails whenever a later function requires an earlier carried binding. | This profile chooses graph functions, typed assets, a published catalog/GTL module and a cumulative environment. Product semantics and the concrete GTL/ABG realization stay consumer-owned; environment declarations retain their stated `should` force. |
37	| Control ownership: [four-function loop](#115d-constructive-evaluation-and-yield-loop), A0/A4a/A5/A7/A12/A15/A16 | Computational execution binding separates the operation from its actor or shared module. Typed composition and authority conservation (F4/F6) therefore apply to the function-table row actually invoked: model synthesis cannot acquire next-action or closure authority by producing data those functions consume. | This profile chooses the four functions and ABG admission/traversal divide. A consumer binds each function's inputs, outputs and grants; shared libraries, query access and actor reuse confer no additional operation. |
38	| Outcome and action selection: [constructive loop](#115d-constructive-evaluation-and-yield-loop), A2/A3/A11 | Specification supplies the selected destination (F1); identity/currentness bind the present target (F3); authority limits changes and actions (F6). Outcome-driven selection therefore relates a current gap to exact target assets and obligations before invocation. An available action with no such relation cannot advance the selected work by assertion. | This profile chooses `TargetObligationBinding`, published-action selection and graph-owned re-entry. Product authority owns outcome changes and bounded prerequisite/experiment admission; a reprice request supplies neither. |
39	| Observation, lineage and recovery: [projection-source coherence](#115c-projection-source-coherence), [loop](#115d-constructive-evaluation-and-yield-loop), A1/A1a/A1b/A13/A13a | Information and interpretation distinguish an account from mutable reality (F2/F3). Reference-frame support and composition need authenticated causal inputs (F4/F5), while evidence admission retains its grant (F6). An old ledger cannot defeat contrary current observation; a lost response cannot establish an effect's absence. | This profile requires reachable admitted ledger/event support, projection reconciliation and replay-visible decisions. Its evaluator consumes the admitted snapshot, so affected observations and uncertainty enter that support before dependent reliance. Ledger/replay architecture is an ODD policy, not a universal consequence of finite context. |
40	| Disposition, fitness and liveness: [loop](#115d-constructive-evaluation-and-yield-loop), A4/A8/A9/A10 | Finite control needs lawful stops and continuation (F5), but evidence about activity, permission or a selected treatment does not establish the Product outcome (F1/F6). A lawful `repair` may satisfy its decision predicate while the repaired edge remains falsified; a successful no-action selection may leave work incomplete. | This profile chooses seven closure dispositions, typed no-action and replay-visible yield. A8 binds their decision predicates separately from fitness; core conjunction retains known failure, uncertainty, performance and effects. Yield adds no failure classification of its own. |
41	| Outer closure under refinement: [A6/A14](#115d-constructive-evaluation-and-yield-loop), [11.9](#119-global-convergence-must-be-stable-under-zoom) | Algebraic composition preserves the outer obligation and material joins (F4), while outcome and authority retain the selected target (F1/F6). Therefore a successful inner chain or a smaller post-action target cannot establish the original edge-closure predicate. | This profile requires evidence-before-closure and recursive application at published boundaries. `evaluate_action` binds the pre-action `TargetObligationBinding` and evidence set; authorized deferral changes applicability without proving the original obligation fulfilled. Internal algorithms may remain opaque. |
42	| Authority-path and process evidence: [governance audit](#9-method-governance-and-audit), [UP-010](#117b-real-authority-path-negative-proof-stdo-up-010), sections 12–16 | Evidence and correction require the exact claim to encounter its adverse case (F2/F3/F6). A manufactured refusal says nothing about whether the supported authority path stops before a forbidden effect; mutable-source evidence does not identify the installed subject. Repetition of a practice does not ratify method law. | This profile chooses manual/agentic walkthrough, supported-path negative proof, scenario and installed-dev evidence, dogfooding and release boundaries. Their local conditions remain binding; the method/actor cause distinction does not itself decide conformance. |
43	| Product boundaries and acquisition: [responsibility layers](#8-responsibility-layers-and-local-binding), [invocation](#17-invocation-rule), [cold start](#18-cold-start-reading-order) | Specification ownership keeps common method, domain meaning and local realization distinct (F1/F2/F6). Reference frames then acquire the actual selected Product sources within finite capacity (F3/F5). Neither copied local names nor a generic rule packet supplies the target's meanings or operation grant. | This profile chooses method-folder conventions, Product/self-host boundaries, reading routes and ramp-up questions. The Product supplies concrete bindings; these routes adopt no unselected domain profile and require no unrelated member. |
44	
45	<!-- STDO3_PROFILE_BINDING_END -->
46	
47	## 1. Position
48	
49	`ODD_METHOD.md` exists to make one instruction precise:
50	
51	`using ODD_METHOD, build this product`
52	
53	That instruction should mean something stronger than:
54	
55	- write some product docs
56	- sketch a graph
57	- add a few helper scripts
58	
59	It means:
60	
61	- build the product as a GTL/ABG domain product
62	- define typed domain assets and nodes
63	- publish named graph functions as the constructive carrier
64	- bind them into a GTL module
65	- let ABG own traversal governance, runtime facts, and provenance
66	- let ABG own continuation and re-entry after each publish boundary
67	- keep product commands and services as cooperative bounded-step subsystems that
68	  publish assets or evidence and return control to ABG
69	- expose visible current state as projection over constructive history
70	
71	This is a programming paradigm, not only a documentation preference.
72	
73	The paradigm is:
74	
75	`product = typed asset/domain model + GTL-defined graph functions + ABG traversal-control runtime + governed projection/query surfaces`
76	
77	If the constructive carrier remains hidden in imperative loops, local service logic, or product-specific orchestration scripts, the product is not yet built using ODD method.
78	
79	Within this method, `ODD`, `GTL`, and `ABG` name normative capability roles
80	and construction algebra, not a required repository, package, vendor, or
81	concrete implementation:
82	
83	- `ODD` means **Outcome-Driven Development** and names the graph-native
84	  product-authoring profile;
85	- `GTL` means **Graph Transformation Language** and names the typed declarative
86	  graph-language role; and
87	- `ABG` names the singular traversal-governance and runtime-truth authority
88	  role.
89	
90	`ODD_METHOD.md` owns those concepts in the graph-native bounded context
91	`urn:stdo:bounded-context:graph-native-odd` under the selected complete STDO
92	basis. The context covers the ODD product shape, GTL language role, ABG method
93	role, graph assets, vectors, functions, traversals, and graph/runtime worker and
94	evaluator shorthands defined by this standard. It does not absorb a consuming
95	Product's domain semantics or a concrete runtime's same-spelled carriers.
96	
97	A consumer binds those roles to concrete conforming realizations in its own
98	Product, requirements, design, and immutable dependency identity. A consumer,
99	reference realization, or historical product may prove or falsify conformance;
100	it does not supply method authority.
101	
102	The method has two core jobs:
103	
104	1. describe the product as a declared asset graph in graph-native terms
105	2. ensure automation never outruns a lawful manual traversal of the same graph
106	
107	The graph is not decoration around the process. The graph is the process model. GTL is the language expression of the method. ABG is the traversal governance, binding, and runtime-truth substrate that realizes the GTL program without owning the domain's internal HOW.
108	
109	---
110

Therefore a successful inner chain or a smaller post-action target cannot establish the original edge-closure predicate. | This profile requires evidence-before-closure and recursive application at published boundaries. `evaluate_action` binds the pre-action `TargetObligationBinding` and evidence set; authorized deferral changes applicability without proving the original obligation fulfilled. Internal algorithms may remain opaque. |
| Authority-path and process evidence: [governance audit](#9-method-governance-and-audit), [UP-010](#117b-real-authority-path-negative-proof-stdo-up-010), sections 12–16 | Evidence and correction require the exact claim to encounter its adverse case (F2/F3/F6). A manufactured refusal says nothing about whether the supported authority path stops before a forbidden effect; mutable-source evidence does not identify the installed subject. Repetition of a practice does not ratify method law. | This profile chooses manual/agentic walkthrough, supported-path negative proof, scenario and installed-dev evidence, dogfooding and release boundaries. Their local conditions remain binding; the method/actor cause distinction does not itself decide conformance. |
| Product boundaries and acquisition: [responsibility layers](#8-responsibility-layers-and-local-binding), [invocation](#17-invocation-rule), [cold start](#18-cold-start-reading-order) | Specification ownership keeps common method, domain meaning and local realization distinct (F1/F2/F6). Reference frames then acquire the actual selected Product sources within finite capacity (F3/F5). Neither copied local names nor a generic rule packet supplies the target's meanings or operation grant. | This profile chooses method-folder conventions, Product/self-host boundaries, reading routes and ramp-up questions. The Product supplies concrete bindings; these routes adopt no unselected domain profile and require no unrelated member. |

<!-- STDO3_PROFILE_BINDING_END -->

## 1. Position

`ODD_METHOD.md` exists to make one instruction precise:

`using ODD_METHOD, build this product`

That instruction should mean something stronger than:

- write some product docs
- sketch a graph
- add a few helper scripts

It means:

- build the product as a GTL/ABG domain product
- define typed domain assets and nodes
- publish named graph functions as the constructive carrier
- bind them into a GTL module
- let ABG own traversal governance, runtime facts, and provenance
- let ABG own continuation and re-entry after each publish boundary
- keep product commands and services as cooperative bounded-step subsystems that
  publish assets or evidence and return control to ABG
- expose visible current state as projection over constructive history

This is a programming paradigm, not only a documentation preference.

The paradigm is:

`product = typed asset/domain model + GTL-defined graph functions + ABG traversal-control runtime + governed projection/query surfaces`

If the constructive carrier remains hidden in imperative loops, local service logic, or product-specific orchestration scripts, the product is not yet built using ODD method.

Within this method, `ODD`, `GTL`, and `ABG` name normative capability roles
and construction algebra, not a required repository, package, vendor, or
concrete implementation:

- `ODD` means **Outcome-Driven Development** and names the graph-native
  product-authoring profile;
- `GTL` means **Graph Transformation Language** and names the typed declarative
  graph-language role; and
- `ABG` names the singular traversal-governance and runtime-truth authority
  role.

`ODD_METHOD.md` owns those concepts in the graph-native bounded context
`urn:stdo:bounded-context:graph-native-odd` under the selected complete STDO
basis. The context covers the ODD product shape, GTL language role, ABG method
role, graph assets, vectors, functions, traversals, and graph/runtime worker and
evaluator shorthands defined by this standard. It does not absorb a consuming
Product's domain semantics or a concrete runtime's same-spelled carriers.

A consumer binds those roles to concrete conforming realizations in its own
Product, requirements, design, and immutable dependency identity. A consumer,
reference realization, or historical product may prove or falsify conformance;
it does not supply method authority.

The method has two core jobs:

1. describe the product as a declared asset graph in graph-native terms
2. ensure automation never outruns a lawful manual traversal of the same graph

The graph is not decoration around the process. The graph is the process model. GTL is the language expression of the method. ABG is the traversal governance, binding, and runtime-truth substrate that realizes the GTL program without owning the domain's internal HOW.

# STDO Reference Frame Baseline

## Canonical Compression

`REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md` defines the finite engagement atom. The selected
complete STDO cut defines specification, design, construction, assessment,
disposition, checkpoint, continuation, identity, and release law. This profile
maps three practical engagement frames onto those existing owners:


```text
existing project authority
  + selected complete STDO and Reference Frame Method basis
  + exact governed Product or Product-chain outcome and workspace basis
  + known evaluation inventory, dependencies, and residuals
  -> sufficient direct Worker activation, or materially required coordination
  -> where coordinated: Executive outcome/basis lock and finite ready frontier
  -> Worker and applicable specialist evaluations; Reviewer only where required
  -> closed results, applicable technical triage, and declared conjunction
  -> existing bounded decision authority, result recording, and next lawful action
  -> updated basis, coverage, residuals, and frontier
  -> repeat or stop
```

The [configuration relation](FOUNDATIONS.md#configuration) derives the need to
allocate bounded tasks from finite context, finite attention, dependencies,
capabilities and assurance requirements. It does not derive one hierarchy or
an exhaustive role inventory. This optional profile chooses three useful task
frames: construction, independent assessment where required, and coordination
where long-term delivery cannot be covered by the direct work frame. Their
labels are Worker, Reviewer and Executive. Other admitted configurations may
use a single sufficient frame, peers or adaptive allocation.

This profile consumes the [shared result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra),
[conjunction](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-conjunction) and
[workspace/context relation](FOUNDATIONS.md#workspace-and-context). The
[transformation library](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md) supplies reusable
responsibilities. Exact operation grants and Product-owned adoption retain
their separate authority; the selected configuration cannot grant it.

The three available frames are overlapping evaluation contexts, not a hierarchy
or actor topology. The Worker supplies the candidate subject but never activates the
Reviewer. The Reviewer evaluates but does not implement. The Executive applies
only decision authority already granted by Product, Goals, requirements,
accepted design, ticket, identity, or release law. The Worker carries only the
construction or transformation authority in its admitted intake. No frame gains
admission, publication, mutation, or other operation authority from its label.

This profile also selects twelve generic specialist-frame families: Product,
Product Composition, Design, Design Component, Public Boundary, Entity,
Operator, Owner, Effect, Reuse/Foundation, Install, and Proof. They separate recurring evaluation
questions that otherwise collapse across constitutional `WHAT`, structural
`HOW`, identity, authority, effects, foundations, installed subjects, and
evidence. They are available frame families, not mandatory actors, stages,
components, services, files, or runtime types. An activation selects only the
families material to its exact evaluation and retains an explicit residual for
any material family it cannot cover.

This profile also selects four Product-testing specialist-frame families:
user acceptance, end to end, integration, and unit. They are activated inside
the same conditionally selected engagement relation; they are not new
roles, stages, authorities, or a testing hierarchy. Their ordinary evidence
topology is:

```text
Product and accepted design
  |- user-outcome claims -> user-acceptance frames
  |- runnable causal-path claims -> end-to-end frames
  |- composition-boundary claims -> integration frames
  `- module-owned laws -> unit frames

bound results -> declared conjunction -> Product or release disposition
```

The fan-out assigns claims to their congruent evidence frames; it is not an
authority hierarchy or a claim that one frame decomposes into another.
Evidence may relate through declared conjunction, translation, falsification,
and re-entry. A broader frame cannot make a module-owned law true, and any
number of narrower green frames cannot establish an unevaluated Product
composition or user outcome.

322	## Result algebra
323	
324	A result makes a claim about one predicate on one subject and basis. Its core
325	record contains the predicate, exact subject and basis, verdict, performance,
326	original qualified domain outcome, supporting evidence and citations, unresolved
327	obligations and material effect observations. A reference can carry these when
328	its resolution preserves their meaning and availability. This is a semantic
329	contract, not a mandatory serialization format or additional work carrier.
330	
331	F1 selects the question and F2/F6 restrict its answer to supported evidence.
332	Because an execution can be interrupted and its effects can outlive its actor
333	(F3/F5), evaluation performance, the predicate's truth and effect completion
334	are separate questions. The informational contribution is the recoverable
335	meaning of each answer; the computational contribution is what was performed
336	and observed. The following value choices implement those distinctions.
337	RF-012 and every domain refinement bind all three questions before consuming a
338	label such as `ready` or `refused`; no label decides the other predicates.
339	
340	The verdict has exactly these values:
341	
342	| Value | Meaning for the bound predicate |
343	|---|---|
344	| `satisfied` | Admissible evidence establishes the predicate under its declared evaluation rule. |
345	| `falsified` | Admissible evidence establishes a counterexample or failure of that predicate. |
346	| `indeterminate` | The available admissible evidence does not decide the predicate. |
347	| `out_of_frame` | The predicate is outside the evaluation's bound scope or capability; it is not silently omitted from the wider obligation. |
348	| `invalid_basis` | The subject, governing basis or required interpretation is invalid for the claimed evaluation. |
349	
350	Performance records whether the named predicate's declared evaluation was
351	actually undertaken; it is `performed`, `not_performed` or `unconfirmed`.
352	The activation identifies that evaluation separately from dispatch, admission
353	or the work being assessed. Retain the observed extent, interruption and
354	conclusion in its outcome and evidence. The legal pairs are:
355	
356	| Performance | Permitted verdicts | Meaning |
357	|---|---|---|
358	| `performed` | Any of the five verdicts | Evidence establishes that the evaluation was undertaken, including a scoped basis or capability diagnosis. Its extent and conclusion remain separate facts. |
359	| `not_performed` | Any except `satisfied`, with the evidence condition below | Evidence establishes that the evaluation was not undertaken. Dispatch or admission alone does not establish performance. |
360	| `unconfirmed` | Any except `satisfied`, with the evidence condition below | Whether the evaluation was undertaken is not established. |
361	
362	An interruption does not erase evaluation already undertaken or admissible
363	evidence obtained. A suite aborted after a witnessed failure is performed with
364	that partial extent and falsifies “all tests pass”. A completed load test that
365	cannot generate its required load is performed but indeterminate on the
366	requested service-performance predicate. Neither case is a never-run test.
367	Satisfaction still requires all evidence and completion conditions selected by
368	the predicate's evaluation rule; performed alone proves none of them.
369	
370	When the selected evaluation was not undertaken or its performance is
371	unconfirmed, separately admissible counterevidence to its bound predicate can
372	still establish falsified; an established basis or scope diagnosis can likewise
373	establish invalid_basis or out_of_frame. The result identifies that independent
374	support without inventing execution. Without deciding support it is
375	indeterminate. An absent return establishes neither non-performance nor an
376	undecidable evaluation: retain the missing slot and what is actually known.
377	
378	A missing required judgment stays an absent coverage slot, with the known
379	performance fact or its uncertainty; it is not a fabricated child result. A
380	performed but undecidable evaluation differs from a known unperformed one and
381	from unconfirmed execution. A failed admission check can conclude while
382	downstream work does not. The plan fixes which predicates are required; a
383	precondition is evidence for its dependent evaluation unless the plan separately
384	requires that precondition as a predicate. A concluding basis/scope diagnosis
385	on P reports invalid_basis/out_of_frame on P with its supporting evidence; a
386	different admission predicate is not silently substituted for P. An aborted
387	procedure does not erase separately authenticated counterexamples observed
388	during the attempt. Every result projection preserves these
389	coordinates and the original predicate; a verdict alone is an insufficient
390	handoff where performance is material.
391	
392	An effect observation is `not_requested`, `not_started`, `completed`, `partial`,
393	`reverted` or `unknown`, on its declared observation boundary. These values describe the selected effect and observation
394	boundary, not the predicate verdict. `not_started` needs evidence that the selected effect did not begin, including
395	an authenticated rejection before mutation. Transport dispatch alone proves
396	neither effect completion nor absence; `unknown` includes a lost acknowledgment
397	after possible execution.
398	`reverted` means that at least one part began and every begun part is observed to have been reversed within
399	the declared boundary, with the reversal and any unstarted remainder retained
400	as evidence. For every effect value, the boundary includes each material part
401	the operation may have affected under its supported operating model and any
402	observed departure, whether requested or unintended. Irreversible messages or
403	other material external effects cannot be omitted to improve a result.
404	`partial` means an observed
405	completed part and an observed requested but unexecuted, or reverted, remainder.
406	If any material remainder has unknown completion, the state is `unknown`,
407	retaining the completed parts as evidence. An effect can be completed while
408	the intended product outcome is falsified.
409	An empty local log or discarded context does not establish no effect.
410	`not_requested` states an established effect-free scope under that operating
411	model; lack of a request alone is insufficient. A material possible unintended
412	effect without sufficient observation is `unknown`. If observation establishes
413	that an unrequested possible part did not begin, it contributes `not_requested`
414	at this boundary, retaining that observation and any earlier uncertainty.
415	It is not an uncompleted requested remainder. A requested part observed not to
416	begin remains `not_started`.
417	
418	A refined value is the pair of original domain outcome and cause in its
419	declared reason domain, including an explicit missing-reason case. A domain
420	refinement preserves that qualified original outcome and supplies a
421	total, reason-sensitive map into this record. If the original outcome is too
422	coarse to determine a verdict, its required reason distinguishes the cases; a
423	consumer cannot guess from a word such as `refused`, `ready` or `accepted`.
424	A missing required reason maps the claimed predicate to indeterminate and
425	leaves that contribution inadmissible as deciding support for its slot;
426	retain its raw outcome and unresolved authentication. Its claimed predicate
427	remains indeterminate until admissible evidence decides it. Independently
428	established counterevidence or a basis/scope diagnosis uses the legal pairs above
429	on that same bound predicate; it does not invent execution or completion.
430	Requested or material possible unintended effects without sufficient observation
431	are unknown, never defaulted to not_requested. Unconfirmed evaluation performance
432	stays unconfirmed. Domain meaning stays with its domain owner.
433	No refinement turns failure, undecidability, non-performance or unknown effect
434	completion into greater standing. A new result over a different predicate does
435	not overwrite the earlier result.
436	
437	Candidate availability, candidate fitness and authorised acceptance are three
438	predicates. `candidate_ready` can satisfy availability while fitness remains
439	falsified or unassessed. A lawful yield can satisfy the selected yielding
440	contract while product completion remains unresolved. A decision result binds
441	the predicate “disposition D on subject S at basis B was made under mandate M
442	by its bound authority”. A lawful rejection can satisfy that predicate while
443	candidate fitness remains undecided. Recording the decision is not its authority.
444	A not-applicable classification needs a supported applicability judgment; it is
445	never a synonym for a missing evaluation.
446	
447	A stop reports the actual destination or task predicate through this record,
448	with its reason, observed effects and outstanding obligations. Its verdict
449	is indeterminate when the outcome remains undecided, falsified when admissible
450	evidence defeats that predicate, or the established scope/basis diagnosis.
451	Lawfulness of stopping is a separate decision predicate.
452	
453	## Result conjunction
454	
455	Conjunction evaluates whether all required predicates and their material joins
456	hold on the declared composite subject and basis. It retains the contributing
457	results, their authentication and predicate mapping, known failures and their
458	citations, uncovered required coverage, uncertain effects and invalidators.
459	The aggregate is another result in the same algebra, with those components
460	available through sufficient references. Its summary never replaces them.
461	
462	The required set comes from the composite's applicability and coverage
463	contract, not from the list of returns received. F4's preservation obligation
464	therefore makes a missing required return visible even when every available
465	return is satisfied. F2/F6 also retain an authenticated counterexample when
466	another slot is missing. Frame conjunction and the library's Conjoin operation
467	apply this same distinction; their owners supply which predicates and joins
468	are required, not another rule for erasing failures or filling gaps.
469	
470	The aggregate evaluation has performance performed when its combining rule is
471	applied; this does not change component performance. The composite declares its
472	effect boundary and the selected effect parts within it. First resolve a current
473	observation for each part, retaining the contributing observations, identities,
474	ordering and any supported supersession. A later timestamp alone is no
475	supersession argument. Conflicting or insufficient observations leave the part
476	unknown. Normalize every material possibly affected part, including one owned
477	by an absent evaluation slot, through the effect-observation rule in
478	[Result algebra](#result-algebra). That rule distinguishes a requested part
479	that did not start from an unrequested possible part observed not to begin.
480	The composite supplies no different classification for either case.
481	
482	Sequential stages can affect the same part. Their local completion labels are
483	not inputs to the composite join until mapped onto that part's observed state
484	at the composite boundary. A completed deployment followed by its completed
485	rollback is reverted for the deployment effect; a subsequent completed
486	reapplication is completed there. The historical rollback remains evidence.
487	The declarations retain every material external part, including irreversible
488	ones; a local reversal cannot silently remove them from the scope.
489	
490	Over the resulting disjoint part observations: any unknown gives unknown;
491	all not_requested gives not_requested; completed with only completed or
492	not_requested gives completed; not_started with only not_started or
493	not_requested gives not_started; reverted with only reverted, not_started or
494	not_requested gives reverted; every remaining fully observed mixture gives
495	partial. Retain each observation's part and contributing components. The combining
496	operation's own lack of mutation cannot label an effectful composite not_requested.
497	
498	First authenticate each contribution against its producer, subject, basis and
499	required plan membership. An unauthenticated claim cannot discharge an
500	obligation. A missing planned judgment remains an absent slot with its known performance
501	fact or uncertainty; required coverage outside an authenticated plan remains
502	uncovered. These are separate
503	conditions. An invalid contribution does not erase an independently
504	authenticated finding.
505	
506	For an interpretable composite predicate and governing basis:
507	
508	1. Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes
509	   the conjunction `falsified`. Missing or undecidable other coverage remains
510	   explicit alongside it.
511	2. With no such falsification, an invalid required basis prevents satisfaction
512	   and yields `invalid_basis`; a required out-of-frame judgment yields
513	   `out_of_frame` when no invalid basis applies.
514	3. Otherwise any unresolved applicability, missing evaluation, undecidable
515	   predicate or undecided material join yields `indeterminate`.
516	4. `satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be
517	   authentically satisfied, with coverage itself established. An empty list
518	   proves nothing unless the declared required set is established as empty.
519	
520	The composite declaration distinguishes its admission conditions from the
521	material joins of the predicate being evaluated. Each relation has one of
522	those roles in that evaluation. A failed admission condition prevents an
523	interpretation; a false required join is counterevidence within an admitted
524	interpretation. The result names that declared role instead of reclassifying a
525	known failed join as a missing basis. If the composite subject or governing basis itself cannot be interpreted, the
526	aggregate is `invalid_basis`; independently valid component failures and their
527	scope remain exposed. This does not pronounce them false or forgotten.
528	Effect uncertainty prevents satisfaction where the predicate requires a known
529	effect state. An unrelated effect does not automatically invalidate a different
530	predicate; the dependency relation must justify its relevance.
531	
532	A declared operator states its truth and falsity conditions over exact leaf
533	predicates and joins. On its fully decided admitted domain, those conditions
534	are disjoint and exhaustive, including failure of a required join. An
535	overlapping, incomplete or uninterpretable operator declaration is invalid_basis.
536	Unresolved well-formedness makes the operator result indeterminate and supplies
537	neither satisfaction nor falsification; independently valid leaf results remain
538	visible. Once well-formedness is established, its result can be satisfied only when authenticated
539	evidence establishes its truth condition and the material joins and coverage
540	needed for that condition. It can be falsified only on an established falsity
541	condition. Otherwise a material invalid_basis yields invalid_basis, a material
542	out_of_frame yields out_of_frame when no invalid basis applies, and every
543	remaining undecided case is indeterminate. Only dependencies needed to decide
544	the bound predicate enter that ordering. Authentication, original failure
545	retention, performance and effect composition remain the rules above. Negation
546	or disjunction evaluates a different predicate; it cannot erase a failed leaf
547	or pass that result off as conjunction of all leaves. A first-nonfailure rule
548	cannot turn an undecided fallback into success.
549	
550	Sequential composition records an unreturned dependent evaluation as an absent
551	slot, retaining its observed performance, extent and missing conclusion. A lawful regrouping requires the same interpretable composite basis, required
552	leaf predicates, joins, normalized effect parts and authentication, with no intermediate basis failure
553	hidden by the grouping. On that fixed domain, retained component sets combine
554	by union, the conjunction precedence is associative, and the effect join over
555	normalized disjoint parts is associative. The argument is mathematical: union
556	retains the same authenticated leaves under either grouping; selecting the
557	highest applicable diagnostic in the declared precedence over those leaves
558	has the same result. Normalized disjoint effect observations likewise retain
559	the same parts, so the stated unknown and completion conditions decide the same
560	aggregate. An intermediate result must retain those leaves and parts; a bare
561	verdict cannot establish this equivalence. This grants no associativity to an
562	arbitrary declared operator; regrouping it requires preservation of the same
563	outer predicate and its own demonstrated associativity law. An invalid
564	intermediate join is a failed premise of that rewrite, not evidence that every
565	arbitrary grouping is equivalent. Reordering
566	operations additionally needs an effect-independence law; associativity alone
567	supplies no such permission.
568	
569	Sequential operations compose under their applicable owning contracts:
570	[UP-016/017](DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md#transformation-admission-completeness-stdo-up-016)
571	for design composition and [AC-016](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-016-typed-composition)
572	within a_c. Their returned result applies the operator rule above to the
573	declared outer predicate using
574	its preservation argument and the retained component results. For a pipeline
575	whose contract requires every stage postcondition, this is the conjunction
576	above; a recovery path need not require a failed earlier test to become true.
577	Unexecuted stages remain coverage facts, with no invented evaluations. A
578	sequence without an established outer interpretation or join returns the
579	applicable unresolved or invalid-basis result rather than a guessed success.
580	
581	## Construction assurance

as evidence. For every effect value, the boundary includes each material part
the operation may have affected under its supported operating model and any
observed departure, whether requested or unintended. Irreversible messages or
other material external effects cannot be omitted to improve a result.
`partial` means an observed
completed part and an observed requested but unexecuted, or reverted, remainder.
If any material remainder has unknown completion, the state is `unknown`,
retaining the completed parts as evidence. An effect can be completed while
the intended product outcome is falsified.
An empty local log or discarded context does not establish no effect.
`not_requested` states an established effect-free scope under that operating
model; lack of a request alone is insufficient. A material possible unintended
effect without sufficient observation is `unknown`. If observation establishes
that an unrequested possible part did not begin, it contributes `not_requested`
at this boundary, retaining that observation and any earlier uncertainty.
It is not an uncompleted requested remainder. A requested part observed not to
begin remains `not_started`.

A refined value is the pair of original domain outcome and cause in its
declared reason domain, including an explicit missing-reason case. A domain
refinement preserves that qualified original outcome and supplies a
total, reason-sensitive map into this record. If the original outcome is too
coarse to determine a verdict, its required reason distinguishes the cases; a
consumer cannot guess from a word such as `refused`, `ready` or `accepted`.
A missing required reason maps the claimed predicate to indeterminate and
leaves that contribution inadmissible as deciding support for its slot;
retain its raw outcome and unresolved authentication. Its claimed predicate
remains indeterminate until admissible evidence decides it. Independently
established counterevidence or a basis/scope diagnosis uses the legal pairs above
on that same bound predicate; it does not invent execution or completion.
Requested or material possible unintended effects without sufficient observation
are unknown, never defaulted to not_requested. Unconfirmed evaluation performance
stays unconfirmed. Domain meaning stays with its domain owner.
No refinement turns failure, undecidability, non-performance or unknown effect
completion into greater standing. A new result over a different predicate does
not overwrite the earlier result.

Candidate availability, candidate fitness and authorised acceptance are three
predicates. `candidate_ready` can satisfy availability while fitness remains
falsified or unassessed. A lawful yield can satisfy the selected yielding
contract while product completion remains unresolved. A decision result binds
the predicate “disposition D on subject S at basis B was made under mandate M
by its bound authority”. A lawful rejection can satisfy that predicate while
candidate fitness remains undecided. Recording the decision is not its authority.
A not-applicable classification needs a supported applicability judgment; it is
never a synonym for a missing evaluation.

A stop reports the actual destination or task predicate through this record,
with its reason, observed effects and outstanding obligations. Its verdict
is indeterminate when the outcome remains undecided, falsified when admissible
evidence defeats that predicate, or the established scope/basis diagnosis.
Lawfulness of stopping is a separate decision predicate.

## Result conjunction

Conjunction evaluates whether all required predicates and their material joins
hold on the declared composite subject and basis. It retains the contributing
results, their authentication and predicate mapping, known failures and their
citations, uncovered required coverage, uncertain effects and invalidators.
The aggregate is another result in the same algebra, with those components
available through sufficient references. Its summary never replaces them.

The required set comes from the composite's applicability and coverage
contract, not from the list of returns received. F4's preservation obligation
therefore makes a missing required return visible even when every available
return is satisfied. F2/F6 also retain an authenticated counterexample when
another slot is missing. Frame conjunction and the library's Conjoin operation
apply this same distinction; their owners supply which predicates and joins
are required, not another rule for erasing failures or filling gaps.

The aggregate evaluation has performance performed when its combining rule is
applied; this does not change component performance. The composite declares its
effect boundary and the selected effect parts within it. First resolve a current
observation for each part, retaining the contributing observations, identities,
ordering and any supported supersession. A later timestamp alone is no
supersession argument. Conflicting or insufficient observations leave the part
unknown. Normalize every material possibly affected part, including one owned
by an absent evaluation slot, through the effect-observation rule in
[Result algebra](#result-algebra). That rule distinguishes a requested part
that did not start from an unrequested possible part observed not to begin.
The composite supplies no different classification for either case.

Sequential stages can affect the same part. Their local completion labels are
not inputs to the composite join until mapped onto that part's observed state
at the composite boundary. A completed deployment followed by its completed
rollback is reverted for the deployment effect; a subsequent completed
reapplication is completed there. The historical rollback remains evidence.
The declarations retain every material external part, including irreversible
ones; a local reversal cannot silently remove them from the scope.

Over the resulting disjoint part observations: any unknown gives unknown;
all not_requested gives not_requested; completed with only completed or
not_requested gives completed; not_started with only not_started or
not_requested gives not_started; reverted with only reverted, not_started or
not_requested gives reverted; every remaining fully observed mixture gives
partial. Retain each observation's part and contributing components. The combining
operation's own lack of mutation cannot label an effectful composite not_requested.

First authenticate each contribution against its producer, subject, basis and
required plan membership. An unauthenticated claim cannot discharge an
obligation. A missing planned judgment remains an absent slot with its known performance
fact or uncertainty; required coverage outside an authenticated plan remains
uncovered. These are separate
conditions. An invalid contribution does not erase an independently
authenticated finding.

For an interpretable composite predicate and governing basis:

1. Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes
   the conjunction `falsified`. Missing or undecidable other coverage remains
   explicit alongside it.
2. With no such falsification, an invalid required basis prevents satisfaction
   and yields `invalid_basis`; a required out-of-frame judgment yields
   `out_of_frame` when no invalid basis applies.
3. Otherwise any unresolved applicability, missing evaluation, undecidable
   predicate or undecided material join yields `indeterminate`.
4. `satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be
   authentically satisfied, with coverage itself established. An empty list
   proves nothing unless the declared required set is established as empty.

The composite declaration distinguishes its admission conditions from the
material joins of the predicate being evaluated. Each relation has one of
those roles in that evaluation. A failed admission condition prevents an
interpretation; a false required join is counterevidence within an admitted
interpretation. The result names that declared role instead of reclassifying a
known failed join as a missing basis. If the composite subject or governing basis itself cannot be interpreted, the
aggregate is `invalid_basis`; independently valid component failures and their
scope remain exposed. This does not pronounce them false or forgotten.
Effect uncertainty prevents satisfaction where the predicate requires a known
effect state. An unrelated effect does not automatically invalidate a different
predicate; the dependency relation must justify its relevance.

A declared operator states its truth and falsity conditions over exact leaf
predicates and joins. On its fully decided admitted domain, those conditions
are disjoint and exhaustive, including failure of a required join. An
overlapping, incomplete or uninterpretable operator declaration is invalid_basis.
Unresolved well-formedness makes the operator result indeterminate and supplies
neither satisfaction nor falsification; independently valid leaf results remain
visible. Once well-formedness is established, its result can be satisfied only when authenticated
evidence establishes its truth condition and the material joins and coverage
needed for that condition. It can be falsified only on an established falsity
condition. Otherwise a material invalid_basis yields invalid_basis, a material
out_of_frame yields out_of_frame when no invalid basis applies, and every
remaining undecided case is indeterminate. Only dependencies needed to decide
the bound predicate enter that ordering. Authentication, original failure
retention, performance and effect composition remain the rules above. Negation
or disjunction evaluates a different predicate; it cannot erase a failed leaf
or pass that result off as conjunction of all leaves. A first-nonfailure rule
cannot turn an undecided fallback into success.

Sequential composition records an unreturned dependent evaluation as an absent
slot, retaining its observed performance, extent and missing conclusion. A lawful regrouping requires the same interpretable composite basis, required
leaf predicates, joins, normalized effect parts and authentication, with no intermediate basis failure
hidden by the grouping. On that fixed domain, retained component sets combine
by union, the conjunction precedence is associative, and the effect join over
normalized disjoint parts is associative. The argument is mathematical: union
retains the same authenticated leaves under either grouping; selecting the
highest applicable diagnostic in the declared precedence over those leaves
has the same result. Normalized disjoint effect observations likewise retain
the same parts, so the stated unknown and completion conditions decide the same
aggregate. An intermediate result must retain those leaves and parts; a bare
verdict cannot establish this equivalence. This grants no associativity to an
arbitrary declared operator; regrouping it requires preservation of the same
outer predicate and its own demonstrated associativity law. An invalid
intermediate join is a failed premise of that rewrite, not evidence that every
arbitrary grouping is equivalent. Reordering
operations additionally needs an effect-independence law; associativity alone
supplies no such permission.

Sequential operations compose under their applicable owning contracts:
[UP-016/017](DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md#transformation-admission-completeness-stdo-up-016)
for design composition and [AC-016](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-016-typed-composition)
within a_c. Their returned result applies the operator rule above to the
declared outer predicate using
its preservation argument and the retained component results. For a pipeline
whose contract requires every stage postcondition, this is the conjunction
above; a recovery path need not require a failed earlier test to become true.
Unexecuted stages remain coverage facts, with no invented evaluations. A
sequence without an established outer interpretation or join returns the
applicable unresolved or invalid-basis result rather than a guessed success.

## Construction assurance

# Glossary Semantic Index

This locator index supports Acquire in the [transformation library](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md). The named owning clause determines meaning; [Foundations](FOUNDATIONS.md) explains that separation. A glossary row is no new definition or default interpretation.

## Index Contract

This file contains no semantic definitions and declares no bounded context,
concept, import, translation, equivalence, disambiguation, or authority. It is a
non-deciding index into clauses that own those meanings in the selected complete
STDO release.

Each row records an indexed spelling, the bounded-context identity declared by
the cited owner, and an exact owning clause. The owning clause plus the selected
release basis identifies the candidate meaning. The occurrence being resolved
still supplies its governed scope. A row whose context or owning clause does not
resolve is invalid; the index cannot repair it.

Repeated spellings in different rows are intentional. Equal spelling, index
proximity, a heading, or inclusion in this file creates no identity,
inheritance, import, equivalence, or authority. Resolution follows
`SPEC_METHOD.md#bounded-context-semantic-resolution`; this index supplies no
fallback decision.

## Acquisition use

F2 distinguishes a spelling from its interpreted meaning; F3 binds the owner
and exact basis; F5 requires sufficient bounded acquisition. The index supplies
routes as this guide's glossary convention. At use, resolve the row's owner in the selected
basis and acquire the material clause under
[Workspace and context](FOUNDATIONS.md#workspace-and-context). Apply
[bounded-context semantic resolution](SPEC_METHOD.md#bounded-context-semantic-resolution)
before concluding that the occurrence's route remains ambiguous. A retrieval report uses the
[core result](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra) on route resolution, retaining the
original locator outcome and reason. Resolution in the selected complete basis
is satisfied; a route established invalid in that basis is falsified. Partial
acquisition that neither resolves the route nor establishes its invalidity, or
ambiguity that bounded-context semantic resolution leaves undecided, is
indeterminate. A concluded ambiguity follows its reason under the core rule;
a demonstrated lack of a required unique owner falsifies route resolution.
An unusable basis is invalid_basis. A route outside the bound evaluation scope
is out_of_frame. Acquiring irrelevant members is no condition of resolution.
Missing reasons follow the core rule. None reports semantic acceptance.

## Labels With Several Senses

These routes locate uses of the same spelling in different owning contexts.
The selected occurrence's owner supplies its meaning, predicate and applicable
result mapping. The table adds no definition or precedence between owners.
An unresolved occurrence follows [bounded-context semantic
resolution](SPEC_METHOD.md#bounded-context-semantic-resolution).

| Label | Use to locate | Owning route |
|---|---|---|
| `indeterminate` | Verdict about a bound predicate | [Result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra) |
| `indeterminate` | Intake classification and its reason-sensitive result | [Universal intake triage](SPEC_METHOD.md#universal-intake-triage) |
| `not_applicable` | Supported applicability of a required evaluation | [Applicability and required results](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#applicability-and-required-results) |
| `not_applicable` | A predecessor claim's successor disposition | [Successor baseline conservation](RELEASE_METHOD.md#successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015) |
| `not_applicable` | A phase in a Product's operational lifecycle | [Operational lifecycle sufficiency](SPEC_METHOD.md#operational-lifecycle-sufficiency-rule) |
| `refused` | A method function's outcome and its actual cause | [Method functions](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#method-functions) |
| `refused` | Constraint or basis refusal in a_c | [AC-007](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-007-constraint-and-refusal) |
| `refused` | An adopted traversal judgment | [Traversal judgment kinds](TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE_PROFILE.md#closed-constraint-judgment-residual-and-stop-kinds) |
| `missing` | An absent required judgment, distinct from a returned verdict | [Result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra) |
| `gap` | Uncovered coverage in a conjunction | [Result conjunction](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-conjunction) |
| `gap` | An a_c stop or source residual | [AC-007](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-007-constraint-and-refusal) |
| `disposition` | An authorised decision on a candidate or work item | [Judgment and authority](FOUNDATIONS.md#judgment-and-authority) |
| `disposition` | A predecessor claim's conservation or replacement relation | [Successor baseline conservation](RELEASE_METHOD.md#successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015) |
| `adoption` | A consumer's selection of a release basis | [Selector and consumer adoption](RELEASE_METHOD.md#selector-and-consumer-adoption) |
| `adoption` | Propagation of a shared method change | [Shared method adoption](POSTING_GUIDE.md#shared-method-adoption-and-propagation-stdo-up-012) |
| `Closed` | A ticket or sprint lifecycle status | [Ticket method](TICKET_METHOD.md) |
| `Closed` | A commentary discussion state | [Posting guide](POSTING_GUIDE.md) |

1886	### Construction, Assessment, And Delegation
1887	
1888	The constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review. Where independent
1889	assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the exact live realisation
1890	under the selected computational binding, its authority paths, proof, and
1891	installed subject rather than treating the constructor's summary as sufficient
1892	evidence. This preserves the independent-review relation; it does not prescribe
1893	an actor count. One actor may occupy different roles across different claims
1894	when independence for the assessed claim is preserved.
1895	
1896	The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may accept
1897	and advance routine actions. A proxy may accept preservation, require local
1898	repair, reject a violating candidate, and advance to the next already-
1899	authorized action. It cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing
1900	authority, or accepted design. Such a change re-enters at its owning relation.
1901	
1902	Human ceremony is not required at every transition when the governing basis,
1903	affected cone, decision envelope, and re-entry conditions are already
1904	accepted. This delegation does not weaken direct-human acceptance where
1905	Product or release law requires it.
1906	
1907	When one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact intake
1908	and operation grant, it may enter directly as constructor or Writer. No
1909	Executive activation is required solely to appoint that Writer. The applicable
1910	frame configuration selects coordination when material contexts, authority,
1911	capability or required independence need it; a role or frame name alone does
1912	not create that need. Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
1913	the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
1914	permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
1915	at a boundary owned elsewhere.
1916	
1917	One bounded operation grant may cover its declared construction, status and
1918	checkpoint sequence. Record actual role transitions in the existing work
1919	carrier; a status change alone requires neither a new grant nor rehashing an
1920	unchanged subject. A material change to the operation, subject, territory,
1921	authority or validity conditions still requires the affected binding to be
1922	resolved before effect. Executive mutation restrictions remain applicable.
1923	
1924	### Proportional Disposition
1925	
1926	Assessment evaluates the exact predicate `the candidate closes its declared
1927	cone and preserves every affected governing relation` through the shared
1928	[result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra). It returns evidence and a
1929	proposed semantic disposition. Only the existing decision authority applies
1930	that disposition; an assessment verdict is not acceptance authority.
1931	
1932	| Disposition | Condition on the exact candidate claim | Core verdict |
1933	|---|---|---|
1934	| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation | `satisfied` |
1935	| `local_repair`, demonstrated counterexample | a demonstrated defect defeats the claim while the governing relation remains coherent | `falsified` |
1936	| `local_repair`, inadequate proof | missing or defective proof leaves the candidate claim undecided; the evidence supports a local proof repair | `indeterminate` |
1937	| `re_enter`, defeated candidate | the intended candidate cannot satisfy an interpretable current contract without an owning-layer change | `falsified` |
1938	| `re_enter`, unusable governing basis | the governing requirements cannot supply a coherent interpretation for this assessment | `invalid_basis` |
1939	| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path | `falsified` |
1940	
1941	The proposed remedy retains its original domain outcome; the core verdict does
1942	not choose among remedies. Governing-requirement coherence is an admission
1943	condition here; the candidate's alignment, including its design's alignment
1944	with those requirements, is an evaluated relation. A contradictory design does
1945	not by itself invalidate otherwise interpretable requirements. A proof defect
1946	can falsify the proof's own claim without falsifying the implementation claim.
1947	Apply [Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) to
1948	the assessment and its supporting results; its Result condition supplies the
1949	core verdict and conjunction. A proposed remedy requires supported cause and
1950	authority; the verdict alone neither selects a remedy nor forbids useful
1951	authorised repair. `An exact candidate is available` remains the construction
1952	predicate, separate from this cone-preservation assessment.
1953	
1954	The applied disposition has a separate decision result under the core contract:
1955	the predicate concerns that disposition on the exact subject and basis under
1956	the bound mandate. A lawful recorded `reject` may satisfy that decision
1957	predicate without establishing a candidate counterexample. It never overwrites
1958	the assessment result. The table classifies evidence for a proposed remedy;
1959	it does not turn policy decisions into fitness verdicts.

### Construction, Assessment, And Delegation

The constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review. Where independent
assessment supports promotion, the assessor evaluates the exact live realisation
under the selected computational binding, its authority paths, proof, and
installed subject rather than treating the constructor's summary as sufficient
evidence. This preserves the independent-review relation; it does not prescribe
an actor count. One actor may occupy different roles across different claims
when independence for the assessed claim is preserved.

The governing authority relation declares whether a bounded proxy may accept
and advance routine actions. A proxy may accept preservation, require local
repair, reject a violating candidate, and advance to the next already-
authorized action. It cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing
authority, or accepted design. Such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

Human ceremony is not required at every transition when the governing basis,
affected cone, decision envelope, and re-entry conditions are already
accepted. This delegation does not weaken direct-human acceptance where
Product or release law requires it.

When one capable context has sufficient existing work authority, exact intake
and operation grant, it may enter directly as constructor or Writer. No
Executive activation is required solely to appoint that Writer. The applicable
frame configuration selects coordination when material contexts, authority,
capability or required independence need it; a role or frame name alone does
not create that need. Direct entry preserves execution-contract admission,
the smallest lawful carrier, required assessment and reserved decisions. It
permits bounded work and condition-based result recording, not self-acceptance
at a boundary owned elsewhere.

One bounded operation grant may cover its declared construction, status and
checkpoint sequence. Record actual role transitions in the existing work
carrier; a status change alone requires neither a new grant nor rehashing an
unchanged subject. A material change to the operation, subject, territory,
authority or validity conditions still requires the affected binding to be
resolved before effect. Executive mutation restrictions remain applicable.

### Proportional Disposition

Assessment evaluates the exact predicate `the candidate closes its declared
cone and preserves every affected governing relation` through the shared
[result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra). It returns evidence and a
proposed semantic disposition. Only the existing decision authority applies
that disposition; an assessment verdict is not acceptance authority.

| Disposition | Condition on the exact candidate claim | Core verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation | `satisfied` |
| `local_repair`, demonstrated counterexample | a demonstrated defect defeats the claim while the governing relation remains coherent | `falsified` |
| `local_repair`, inadequate proof | missing or defective proof leaves the candidate claim undecided; the evidence supports a local proof repair | `indeterminate` |
| `re_enter`, defeated candidate | the intended candidate cannot satisfy an interpretable current contract without an owning-layer change | `falsified` |
| `re_enter`, unusable governing basis | the governing requirements cannot supply a coherent interpretation for this assessment | `invalid_basis` |
| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path | `falsified` |

The proposed remedy retains its original domain outcome; the core verdict does
not choose among remedies. Governing-requirement coherence is an admission
condition here; the candidate's alignment, including its design's alignment
with those requirements, is an evaluated relation. A contradictory design does
not by itself invalidate otherwise interpretable requirements. A proof defect
can falsify the proof's own claim without falsifying the implementation claim.
Apply [Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) to
the assessment and its supporting results; its Result condition supplies the
core verdict and conjunction. A proposed remedy requires supported cause and
authority; the verdict alone neither selects a remedy nor forbids useful
authorised repair. `An exact candidate is available` remains the construction
predicate, separate from this cone-preservation assessment.

The applied disposition has a separate decision result under the core contract:
the predicate concerns that disposition on the exact subject and basis under
the bound mandate. A lawful recorded `reject` may satisfy that decision
predicate without establishing a candidate counterexample. It never overwrites
the assessment result. The table classifies evidence for a proposed remedy;
it does not turn policy decisions into fitness verdicts.

790	new independence test.
791	
792	`STDO-UP-020` remains the owner of assessment and semantic disposition. This
793	profile uses an activated Reviewer result as independent live-surface evaluation
794	input and, in the coordinated branch, Executive as the authorized assessor or
795	proxy that applies the one existing disposition. It creates no second verdict or
796	disposition family.
797	
798	Reviewer may assess likely repair complexity and regression risk without
799	becoming the repair owner. When cause, blast radius, workaround, or repair risk
800	cannot be supported inside the activation, the result records that uncertainty
801	instead of manufacturing a complete triage.
802	
803	Tests are inside the Reviewer manifold when their code, fixtures, mutations,
804	environment, or interpretation can change the proof claim. A passing result is
805	not relied upon as a substitute for reviewing those semantics.
806	
807	Each finding binds a violated property, supported entry or state, governing
808	operating/threat model and credible causal path. Apply those conditions to
809	retained guards and acceptance predicates as well as new findings. An excluded
810	threat alone gives no retention claim; a proposed wider threat model re-enters
811	its owner. Internal location alone does not establish trust, and hypothetical
812	hostility alone does not establish applicability. Retain the actual untrusted
813	input, mutable-state, authority and effect checks required by the supported
814	model. A suggested repair becomes an obligation only through its proper owner.
815	
816	---
817	
818	## Derived Generic Specialist Frame Set
819	
820	F1–F4 require an evaluation to preserve the selected outcome, exact subject,
821	meaning and material joins; F5 bounds what one actor can cover; F6 prevents
822	broader coverage from absorbing another owner. Given Product work with those
823	material questions, separate bounded evaluations must retain their claim and
824	authority boundaries. This profile chooses the following twelve archetypes;
825	the cited domain owners supply their predicates and an adopting Product chooses
826	material instantiations. Neither Foundations nor adoption requires twelve
827	actors or components.
828	
829	This profile declares the following generic frame families for Product work.
830	Each row is an evaluation archetype under `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`, not a
831	complete frame declaration. An adopting project binds the exact subject,
832	basis, material manifold, coordinates, invariants, authority, evidence,
833	exclusions, result algebra, capability envelope, dependencies, and
834	invalidation conditions for every activated instance.
835	
836	The family labels resolve inside
837	`urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation` under the selected STDO
838	basis. Under `SPEC_METHOD.md`'s Bounded-Context Semantic Resolution law,
839	`Product`, `Owner`, `Entity`, `Operator`, `Install`, and the other labels do not
840	become equal to same-spelled Product, authority, domain, or runtime concepts.
841	An explicit relation is required at every material cross-context seam.
842	
843	| Frame family | Evaluation family and exact subject | Governing authority and permitted output | Immediate falsifier |
844	|---|---|---|---|
845	| **Product** | Does one exact current Product claim, outcome, boundary, and lifecycle govern the claimed Product subject without downstream reinterpretation? The basis is current Intent, Product, requirements, acceptance meaning, and exact Product coordinates. | Product and requirement authority retain meaning and acceptance. The frame returns only a bounded evaluation result and evidence. | Design, code, tests, a predecessor behavior, or local convention changes Product meaning or substitutes a different Product subject. |

disposition family.

becoming the repair owner. When cause, blast radius, workaround, or repair risk
